subject: GRB 260709A: cubesat Avion detection
submitter: Andrey Bogomolov at Moscow State University <aabboogg@srd.sinp.msu.ru>
body:
From Andrey Bogomolov at Moscow State University <aabboogg@srd.sinp.msu.ru>

At 2026-07-09 ~01:07:32 UT the long-duration GRB 260709A (Fermi/GBM detection: GCN #45121, GECAM-B detection: GCN #45136, SVOM/GRM detection: GCN #45137, AstroSat detection: GCN #45164) was detected by the DeCoR-1 and DeCoR-3 instruments on the cubesat Avion of the Moscow University project “Sozvezdie-270” [1].

Total amount of photons detected by Avion is 100 (energy band >40 keV), it corresponds to a fluence of ~4.5*10^(-7) erg/cm^2 in the range 40-500 keV.

LC in the energy range of 40-500 keV consists of several peaks of various intensity, a maximum flux is ~2 phot/(cm^2*s) at the central peak at 01:07:32 UT.

А total duration (T90) of the burst is ~18 s.

The light curve obtained by Avion is available here:
https://swx.sinp.msu.ru/models/grb_cat/data/pictures/GRB260709A_LC_Avion.png

Parameters of GRB 260709A as well as other GRBs detected by Moscow University cubesats are listed at: https://swx.sinp.msu.ru/models/grb_cat/grb.php?lang=en

Avion is one of 5 cubesats of the Moscow University project “Sozvezdie-270” [1] launched on 2023 June 27. The payload of Avion is a set of scintillation gamma-ray detectors DeCoR [2], the energy range is  >30 keV, the time resolution is 0.5s.

[1] Svertilov et al. 2023  https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-50248-4_21
[2] Bogomolov et al. 2026 Cosmic Research 64, 262 https://link.springer.com/article/10.1134/S0010952526600071
